items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday). Period is 14 days 'ab dem Rechnungsdatum'. Following standard commercial counting for a period stated 'ab' a calendar date, the due date is 14 days after the invoice date: 19.11.2026 + 14 days = 03.12.2026. 03.12.2026 falls on a Thursday (14 days = exactly 2 weeks after Thursday 19.11.2026), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed.
